summary.text: John Gaskey is a Republican state representative from Carver who has represented the 2nd Plymouth District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the U.S. Coast Guard for 23 years and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Gaskey served in the U.S. Coast Guard for 23 years, according to Ballotpedia, and took office in the Massachusetts House on January 1, 2025.

He is the ranking minority member of the House Committee on Climate Action and Sustainability and also serves on the House Committee on Operations, Facilities and Security and the Joint Committees on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity; Environment and Natural Resources; and Veterans and Federal Affairs.
